Subject: Invoice delivery and VAT evidence for Redwood services

Hi Rishi,

We're finalizing onboarding for Redwood and have a couple of questions from AP before we can activate the payment flow. Two quick items:

1) How will invoices be delivered? Our default is an AP portal (SFTP/API) but for some smaller vendors we accept signed PDFs via encrypted email.
2) For EU VAT reconciliation, we need a signed VAT certificate or EU VAT registration evidence attached to the invoice. Is there an automated way to attach that or to surface VAT meta on the invoice (VAT ID + reverse-charge flag)?

Attached a sample PO and our AP intake checklist. If possible we'd like a short list of options and any caveats (SLA, token exchange, or any manual steps).

Thanks,
Lucas
Lucas Graham
Accounts Payable Manager
Acme Corp

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery and VAT evidence for Redwood services

Hi Lucas — thanks for the PO and checklist. Looping in Kimberly (billing ops) and Marissa (finance) so we can surface concrete options. High level:

- Portal/API (recommended): We push invoices to your AP system via SFTP or a webhook. This supports structured UBL/UBL-extended (XML) or PDF+JSON metadata. We can include VAT ID and a reverse-charge flag in metadata so your reconciliation is automatic.
- Signed PDF via encrypted email (fallback): We can send a PGP/SMIME-encrypted signed PDF that includes an embedded VAT attachment (PDF). This is manual to set up and has longer SLA (24–72 hours) for certificate exchange.
- Tokenized delivery for high-trust partners: We offer a time-bound signed token (JWT) that the portal verifies; useful if you want single-click archival + signed evidence.

Kimberly — can you confirm any constraints on the token exchange or if we can provide a signed VAT certificate as a separate artifact on every invoice? Marissa — any billing/GL flags we should make sure are present for your AP team?

Next steps: if Acme prefers the portal/API path, we can provision credentials (SFTP user or API key) and push a test invoice within 3 business days. If you need a signed VAT certificate for the EU reverse-charge, we can attach acme_vat_certificate.pdf to each invoice or expose a VAT-evidence link in the invoice metadata.

Rishi
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Lucas Graham <lucas.graham@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery and VAT evidence for Redwood services

Hi all,

A few practical notes from billing ops:

- Portal/API: Preferred for straight-through processing. We support:
  * SFTP drop (daily/real-time) with filename pattern and manifest.
  * HTTPS webhook with HMAC or mutual TLS.
  * XML (UBL) or PDF+JSON payload. For VAT reconciliation use the JSON fields: vendor_vat_id, buyer_vat_id, reverse_charge_flag, vat_amount.

- Encrypted email: We can deliver SMIME-encrypted PDFs if Acme's security team provides our public key. That path is slower: cert provisioning + test cycle typically 2–3 business days. Not ideal for high invoice volume.

- Signed VAT evidence: We can either:
  1) Embed acme_vat_certificate.pdf as an attachment on every invoice (recommended if your AP needs the doc inline).
  2) Host a secure per-invoice evidence URL (signed, expires after 90 days) and include that URL in invoice metadata.

- SLA/cutoffs: For portal pushes we have a 7pm UTC cut for same-day generation. Encrypted email deliveries are processed in nightly batches (next-business-day at the earliest).

If Acme wants the portal route, please confirm: preferred transport (SFTP vs API), required file format (XML vs PDF+JSON), and whether you need the VAT cert attached or a hosted evidence URL.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Billing Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: sample_invoice_payload.json (example schema)
From: Lucas Graham <lucas.graham@acme-corp.com>

Cc: AP Team <ap@acme-corp.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery options and VAT evidence: portal auth vs encrypted email

Thanks — this is very helpful. Acme's preference is:

- Primary: Portal/API via HTTPS webhook with HMAC (we prefer webhooks to SFTP).
- Format: PDF+JSON (our system expects a PDF and separate JSON metadata).
- VAT evidence: Please attach the VAT certificate as a PDF to each invoice for the first 6 months while we complete tax team verification. After that, the hosted evidence URL is acceptable.

We can provide an HMAC secret and the test webhook endpoint by EOD tomorrow. Please treat the initial onboarding as a P0 so we can flip payments live in April.

Would you also send a short mutual action plan (timeline + who-does-what) so I can align our tax and procurement teams?

Lucas
Accounts Payable Manager
Acme Corp
